text:
Priya: Quick sync — timeline pressure on the next release. Proposal: sunset the Admin Audit View for MVP and move advanced role-mapping to v1. This buys dev + infra time for perf and stability. Thoughts?
Marco: Agree on sunsetting Audit View for MVP. Does anyone have a rough dev estimate for removing the UI?
Lena: Audit View is ~2.5 dev-weeks (frontend + QA) plus ~1 infra-day for log export stabilizers. Role-mapping (advanced rules) is infra+design heavy. My recommendation: cut full UI, keep a basic export endpoint for enterprise pilots.
Josh: If we cut the UI we can reallocate 2 devs to streaming perf work. :+1:
Priya: @Lena can you drop a minimal cut plan here (PRs to revert + feature flag name) today? Need to update the roadmap slide.
Lena: Will do. Draft plan: 1) add feature flag `feature.audit_view_enabled` (default off for MVP), 2) add export-only API `/admin/audit/export`, 3) remove UI routes from release bundle, 4) smoke tests. Low-risk path.
Marco: Export-only endpoint as compromise sounds reasonable for Acme and other enterprise pilots. Tag it "pilot-only must-have" in rollout notes.
Lena: Note: export endpoint has an auth edge-case with token refresh we saw in staging. I'll open a ticket.
QA-Bot: Regression tests: `audit_export` endpoint currently failing bearer auth on staging. Created ticket #1234 with logs.
Priya: Thanks. Finalize decision for roadmap: MVP = core generation routes + admin export endpoint; v1 = full Audit View + advanced role-mapping and role-mapping UI. We'll update milestone and notify sales. @Josh please schedule a 30m dev sync tomorrow.
Josh: Booked 10:00 AM PT tomorrow. I'll bring perf numbers and delta if we reassign the two devs.
Priya: :thumbsup: One more question — any objections to rebaselining the public target date by +2 weeks to absorb the cut and QA?
Marco: No objections. Stability > rushed polish.
Lena: Fine with +2 weeks.
Sales-Bot: FYI: ACME legal requires explicit confirmation on audit retention before next Tuesday. Tagging @Priya for follow-up.
Priya: Copy — I'll ping legal after we post the cut plan and export contract language.
Marco: Also add a short FAQ in the release notes: why Audit View is deferred, how to use the export endpoint, and timelines for v1.
Priya: Good call. Lena, can you draft the FAQ snippet with endpoints and example curl for export?
Lena: Yep, sample curl I plan to include: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/admin/audit/export?start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-15`
Priya: Perfect. I'll update the roadmap doc and ping sales + legal once the plan is posted. Thanks everyone — we'll treat this as the official MVP boundary unless objections surface by EOD.
